description: An S-3 operations officer must approve the next-day access plan for an HVAC contractor, a generator inspection team, and a medical oxygen delivery at a forward operating base, including gates, escort requirements, staging, and delivery timing.

shared_context.S1: The forward operating base has Gate 1 on the east perimeter and Gate 2 on the south perimeter; both gates can process scheduled service vehicles.
shared_context.S2: The HVAC contractor is scheduled for 0800, the generator inspection team for 1000, and the medical oxygen delivery for 1100 tomorrow.
shared_context.S3: The normal access plan uses Gate 1, stages service vehicles on the North Apron, and requires routine visitor sign-in at the arrival gate.
shared_context.S4: Maj. Alvarez approves the final access plan and records any escort, staging, or delivery controls.
shared_context.S5: During the daily access coordination huddle, Maj. Alvarez asks the security, facilities, and medical-logistics representatives to confirm updates before the plan is approved.

PF1.text: A base security directive issued at 0700 today requires all contractor vehicles for the HVAC and generator teams to enter through Gate 2 and remain under a security escort from entry until departure; Capt. Brooks received the signed directive from the base security cell, but the gate notice has not yet been posted.

PF2.text: The North Apron will be closed tomorrow from 0730 through 1230 for a resurfacing inspection, so all three service vehicles must stage in the South Service Lot; Lt. Mercer confirmed the closure with the engineering crew this afternoon, but the facilities closure board has not yet been updated.

PF3.text: The medical oxygen carrier has a confirmed receiving appointment from exactly 1030 to 1100 and must be processed as a priority medical delivery through Gate 1; Sgt. Patel confirmed the appointment with the carrier this morning, but the appointment is still only in the medical logistics tracker.

acceptance_conditions: The HVAC contractor must enter through Gate 2.
The generator inspection team must enter through Gate 2.
The contractor_escort decision must specify an escort for the HVAC and generator teams.
All three service vehicles must stage in the South Service Lot.
The oxygen delivery must use Gate 1 during the exact 1030-1100 receiving window.
The oxygen delivery must be marked as a priority medical delivery.
The plan must include a gate notice or escort-coordination commitment for the contractor controls.

content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'gate_notice' or c['type'] == 'gate_notice_posting' or c['type'] == 'escort_coordination' or c['type'] == 'security_escort_coordination' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The signed security directive changes both contractor entry assignments from Gate 1 to Gate 2, changes the contractor_escort decision to require an escort, and prompts a gate-notice or escort-coordination commitment.
The 0730-1230 North Apron closure changes the service_vehicle_staging decision from North Apron to South Service Lot.

The confirmed 1030-1100 appointment changes the oxygen delivery's gate to Gate 1, fixes its receiving window to 1030-1100, changes its handling status to priority medical delivery, and supplies the fact that must be cited and revealed.
